headline: SDP @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.10 at STL 4.34, with a projected total of 8.44. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved +0.96 runs while STL moved +0.45, changing the projected margin by +0.52 runs. The projected total climbed +1.41, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Dustin May has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Jordan Walker, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
